{{Quote|What is this, a staring contest? Why don't they just send us in?''"<br />"''We go when we go. Quit complaining.|Another soldier and this Human converse|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="GenderCite" /> served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Mantellian Army]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] can be heard in the Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> the [[Mantellian Trooper]] participated in the Republic's [[Blockade of Talloran village|blockade]] of [[Talloran village]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> intended to contain the Separatist forces that had [[Takeover of Talloran village|seized control]] of the settlement.<ref name="Desperate Times">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Desperate Times|Ord Mantell}}</ref> While waiting, they scolded a [[Unidentified Mantellian soldier 1 (blockade of Talloran)|comrade]] who complained about how little the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were doing.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The Human soldier had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin, and wore the blue [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] commonly used by personnel of the Mantellian [[Army/Legends|Army]], with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] strapped to their back. They did not mind the waiting during the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], and chided another soldier who did.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier appears in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, the soldier is identified as "Dutiful Soldier."<ref name="SWTOR" />
